# Code map

Autoloads: `EventBus` (autoload/event_bus.gd), `ContentDB` (autoload/content_db.gd), `Rng` (autoload/rng_service.gd), `SaveService` (autoload/save_service.gd), `GameState` (autoload/game_state.gd), `Sound` (autoload/sound_service.gd), `Profile` (autoload/profile_service.gd), `Tutorial` (autoload/tutorial_service.gd), `DevShots` (core/dev/dev_shots.gd)

## autoload/

| File | Class | What | Public functions |
|---|---|---|---|
| `autoload/content_db.gd` |  | Loads and validates all content once at start-up. If `errors` is not empty the game must not start. | reload, is_ok |
| `autoload/event_bus.gd` |  | Global signals. Systems talk through these instead of holding references to each other. |  |
| `autoload/game_state.gd` |  | Facade between the screens and the game rules (GDD 19.3): the place and day actions — contracts, rumors, the | accept_contract, craft_item, upgrade_module, salvage_item, leave_workshop, investigate_rumor, work_shift, rest, treat, calm_voice, verify_rumor, study_trophy, buy_item, sell_sample, sell_stock, raise_attribute, buy_skill, reset_skills |
| `autoload/game_state_core.gd` |  | Core of the GameState facade (GDD 19.3): the run, saving, days, gear and fights. autoload/game_state.gd extends it | has_run, new_game, continue_game, save_game, move_hero, is_open, set_hero_node, end_day, equip_module, unequip_module, set_socket, dev_grant_all_gear, start_hunt, combat_play, combat_end_turn, finish_combat, lost_control |
| `autoload/profile_service.gd` |  | The player profile (ProfileState in user://profile.cfg): settings screen and tutorial read and change it here. | save, apply, apply_volumes, set_volume, set_fullscreen, set_hints, reset_tutorial |
| `autoload/rng_service.gd` |  | Seeded randomness (GDD 17.1). One master seed per playthrough; every system draws from its own | set_seed, stream |
| `autoload/save_service.gd` |  | Save / load of RunState as JSON, with versioned migrations (GDD 19.1). | has_save, save_run, load_run |
| `autoload/sound_service.gd` |  | Plays the game's sounds (GDD 24): short sounds by id, creature voices, music and ambience per screen. | play, play_monster, screen, zone |
| `autoload/tutorial_service.gd` |  | Tutorial hints (GDD 22): screens call Tutorial.trigger(&"combat_start") and Tutorial.action(&"end_turn"); fight | trigger, action |

## tools/

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `tools/check_district_map.py` | Render a district map's data (data/city/district_maps/<ID>.json) over its art to check the calibration (GDD 20.9 step 6b). |
| `tools/check_map_regions.py` | Render data/city/map_regions.json over the city map art to check the traced regions. |
| `tools/gen_locale.py` | Keep locale/strings.csv (keys, ru, en) in step with the game data (GDD 22.5). |
| `tools/gen_reference.py` | Reference files for Claude (and people): where everything is, without searching the code. |
| `tools/import_art.py` | Import source art from assets/ into the game folder art/. |
| `tools/import_audio.py` | Copy the sounds the game uses from the owner's sound kit into audio/ (committed), under game names. |
| `tools/life_sprites.py` | Map-life sheets (docs/art-prompts/map-life-people.md): assets/ui/LIFE__<set>__sheet.png is a 4 x 2 grid of figures; |
| `tools/tune_monsters.py` | Apply a tuning table to a monsters file. |
| `tools/check_all.sh` | One-stop project check (run from the project root in Git Bash): |
